## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- Claims 2–4 establish the algebraic presentation and required boundary classification, including the distinction between a nonempty zero-row family and its zero row lattice.
- Claim 5 correctly identifies the remaining deficiency: artifact `a3ad933b835c991bc8edccec918dce17c0e4594e4d1d4281e32946dd7e508ece` covers only degrees \(4,\ldots,30\). No evidence identifies its indexed rows in degrees \(31,\ldots,35\). Hence literal all-degree equality with the artifact’s rows is not established, although row-lattice equality is.

## Unresolved certificates
- [computation] Extend the same partition-Pieri construction through degrees \(4,\ldots,35\), preserving ordered row labels and \(|R_d|\times0\) matrices for \(31\le d\le35\), and verify exact labelled-row agreement with artifact `a3ad933b835c991bc8edccec918dce17c0e4594e4d1d4281e32946dd7e508ece` in degrees \(4,\ldots,30\).
